(()=>{const m="SIT 자동 테스트";const vis=e=>!!(e.offsetWidth||e.offsetHeight);const ymd=(()=>{const d=new Date();return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');})();document.querySelectorAll('[metaessential="1"]').forEach(e=>{if(!vis(e)||e.readOnly||e.disabled)return;const id=e.id||'';if(e.tagName==='SELECT'){if(!e.value){const o=[...e.options].find(x=>x.value!==''&&!/선택|전체/.test(x.text));if(o){e.value=o.value;e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}}}else if(e.type==='radio'){const g=document.querySelectorAll('input[type=radio][name="'+e.name+'"]');if(![...g].some(x=>x.checked))g[0].click();}else if(e.type==='checkbox'){}else if(e.tagName==='TEXTAREA'){if(!e.value.trim()){e.value=m;e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}}else if(e.tagName==='INPUT'&&!e.value.trim()){let v=m;if(/YMD|DT_|DATE/i.test(id))v=ymd;if(/TIME|HH/i.test(id))v='10';if(/MINUTE|MI$/i.test(id))v='00';e.value=v;e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}});})()
